## [1.0.4] - 2026-09-28

### Added
- Weekly CI job (`compat.yml`) guarding host compatibility: floats
  `@opencode/plugin` to the latest 2.x and re-runs typecheck + tests, *and*
  boots a real isolated OpenCode server (`scripts/live-smoke.sh`) asserting
  `/goal` registers — drift is caught before users hit it. Manual trigger:
  `gh workflow run compat.yml`.
- `CHANGELOG.md` (this file, shipped in the npm package), `CONTRIBUTING.md`,
  and issue/PR templates.
- Demo GIF in the README, reproducible via `vhs scripts/demo.tape` against a
  throwaway environment (`scripts/demo-env.sh`).
- GitHub releases now take their notes from this file's matching section.

### Changed
- Development toolchain upgraded to TypeScript 7 (`tsc` 7.0.2, native port);
  typecheck and tests pass with zero source changes. No runtime impact.
- CI uses `actions/checkout@v7`.

Goal-state check before evidence/reason gating: `goal_complete`, `goal_block`, and their slash-command twins now report the goal's actual state (terminal, absent, paused) instead of demanding evidence when there's nothing to complete. README audit: documented `continuationText`, command aliases (`status`/`done`/`blocked`/`tasks`/`log`, `--cap N`, bare `/goal <objective>`), and the `todo` task status.

### Fixed

releases.name: v1.0.1 — installs from npm
releases.body:
## Fixes

- **npm install now resolves.** v1.0.0 failed inside OpenCode's plugin installer (`NpmInstallFailedError`: npm auto-installs peerDependencies, and our `solid-js ^1.9.15` peer collided with `@opentui/solid`'s pinned `1.9.12`). Host-provided TUI peers are now marked optional via `peerDependenciesMeta`, and the solid-js floor matches what the ecosystem ships.

## Install

```jsonc
// ~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc — no clone needed
{ "plugins": ["opencode2-goals"] }
```

`opencode2-goals@1.0.0` is deprecated on npm; install `@latest`.

## Known issue

The sidebar widget does not yet load from the npm tarball — point `cli.json` at a local checkout for the TUI entry until [issue #3](https://github.com/wukrit/opencode2-goals/issues/3) is resolved. The server plugin (the entire goal loop) is unaffected.

releases.name: v1.0.0 — the goal loop is out
releases.body:
First public release. A durable, session-scoped goal loop for OpenCode v2, in the public domain.

## What you get

- **`/goal` command surface** — `set | view | pause | resume | clear | complete | block | history` plus `task` subcommands. Safe by default: 10-turn / 100k-token caps unless you pass `--turns/--tokens` or explicitly `--unbounded`.
- **Evidence-gated completion** — `goal_complete` only accepts concrete, transcript-grounded evidence (path, number, test result, command output). Weak claims are rejected and the goal stays active.
- **Model-callable tools** — `goal_set` (refuses to clobber a live goal), `goal_complete`, `goal_block`, `goal_clear` (only on a transcript-grounded quote of *your* request — the model can't erase its tracks), `goal_add_task`/`goal_update_task`, and read-only `goal_history`.
- **Event-driven continuation** — objective re-injected into every agent-loop call; exactly one continuation per idle boundary; stall suppression when a turn makes no tool call; distinct `budget_limited` outcome when caps are hit.
- **Unattended permission sandbox** — in-scope file paths auto-allowed, out-of-scope denied with a steer to `goal_block`; configured denies are never widened.
- **Durable history** — terminal and superseded goals are archived per session; `/goal history` renders them newest-first.
- **Live sidebar widget** — three sections: objective, aligned counter grid (`Status/Turns/Tokens/Tasks` + task progress bar), task list. Legible in dark *and* light themes.

## Install (local directory — nothing on npm)

```sh
git clone https://github.com/wukrit/opencode2-goals.git ~/Projects/opencode2-goals
```

Then add `{ "package": "/Users/you/Projects/opencode2-goals" }` to `plugins` in `~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc` (and `cli.json` for the widget), followed by `opencode api post /api/location/reload`. Full docs in the README.

## Known limitations (honest by design)

- Evidence gating is a **heuristic**, not semantic verification.
- Two loaded locations sharing one project id can race (no atomic claim in plugin storage) — keep locations on distinct projects, single server process.
- Non-path permission prompts (shell/URL) remain manual.

Requires OpenCode 2.x (live-verified on 2.0.16) and a local-directory plugin load. License: The Unlicense (public domain).
